audit_member_text: VISCOSITY_WMAKER lists Xc_WK and Yc_WK twice in one USE GLOBAL, ONLY list across L2486-L2487. This copy-paste duplicate is rejected by some Fortran compilers as a repeated use-associated name and has no semantic need.

In parallel out-of-range handling, CalcPeriodicTheta calls MPI_FINALIZE at L1070 but has no STOP or RETURN before normal computation resumes at L1076-L1078; serial builds STOP at L1074. Whether MPI_FINALIZE returns makes the purported fatal range guard ineffective and permits post-finalization execution.

WK_NEW_DATA2D deliberately sets NumDir=2 at L448 while allocating all generated second dimensions as one at L450-L452 and L495-L499. The called new routines declare fixed second dimension one and mostly ignore mtheta/NumDir (L2646-L2655, L3061-L3065), so the metadata says two directions while storage and computation implement one; any downstream consumer that trusts NumDir can exceed these arrays.
